entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The black-green guild of Ravnica, embodiment of life and death, which handles agriculture and waste reclamation and raises its dead as plant zombies.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane and city that is home to the Golgari Swarm and the other guilds.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: A devkarin necromancer-turned-lich who founded the Golgari Swarm and is its revered parun.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: The Devkarin matka who seized control of the Golgari with Szadek's help and proclaimed herself guildmaster; Jarad's sister.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: Savra's brother, who took control of the Golgari Swarm after Szadek's defeat and survived death as a zombie/lich.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: A House Dimir parun and guildmaster who helped Savra take the guild, then double-crossed her.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker, former leader of the Ochran, who became Golgari guildmaster, was compleated, and led the Phyrexian forces on Ravnica.

entities.name: Sisters of Stone Death
entities.description: Originally a quintet of gorgons who overthrew Svogthir and ruled the Swarm until Savra's takeover.

entities.name: Teratogens
entities.description: The former ruling class of the Golgari, mostly non-humanoids such as plant zombies, mutants, harpies and gorgons.

entities.name: Devkarin
entities.description: A brooding, ambitious race of elves who press most for expansion of Golgari territory, led by their Matka.

entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: The current Matka of the Devkarin; the only leader who did not accept Vraska's return.

entities.name: Cilia
entities.description: A council of Devkarin shamans and rogues acting as Jarad's advisory parliament and spy agency.

entities.name: Lotleth
entities.description: The Golgari's irregular faction of undead, necromancers and fungus-binders.

entities.name: Wratislav
entities.description: A skilled but conceited human necromancer who leads the Lotleth.

entities.name: Kraul
entities.description: Six-legged insectile beings on the Swarm's periphery who, under Mazirek, are loyal to Vraska.

entities.name: Mazirek
entities.description: Kraul leader under whom the Kraul are loyal to Vraska.

entities.name: Street Swarm
entities.description: The Golgari labor class of scavengers, shamans, rot farmers and fungal horrors.

entities.name: Ochran
entities.description: A Golgari cult of mercenaries specializing in vengeance killings, formerly led by Vraska.

entities.name: Erstwhile
entities.description: A delicate race of elves laid to rest in Umerilek who returned as intelligent zombie attendants of Vraska.

entities.name: Storrev
entities.description: The lich who leads the Erstwhile.

entities.name: Cisarzim
entities.description: A Gruul Clans parun whose chest Svogthir used to modify his own body.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild Savra tried to infiltrate and seize.

entities.name: Izolda
entities.description: The Blood Witch who sacrificed Jarad in a ritual to arouse Rakdos.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The parun of the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Svogthos
entities.description: The semi-living former Orzhov cathedral that serves as Golgari guildhall and houses Svogthir's severed head.

entities.name: Korozda
entities.description: A maze of overgrown ruins around Svogthos that was Jarad's lair; brought to the surface by the Invasion Tree.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who rewarded Vraska with the location of Jarad and later invaded Ravnica.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Azorius guildmaster killed by Vraska.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Vraska fled from after killing Isperia, and who later sought Golgari support against Bolas.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Ral, tried to win the Golgari leaders to their cause.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker whose team helped evacuate civilians from Ravnica's surface.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact secured on Ixalan with Vraska's help.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane where Vraska helped secure the Immortal Sun and later fled.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas' undead army invading Ravnica.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion in which the Golgari fell to compleation and spearheaded the attack on Ravnica.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: The ten-thousandth anniversary of the Guildpact, around which the Teratogens lost hegemony of the Golgari.

events.summary: Svogthir, a devkarin necromancer turned lich, founds the Golgari Swarm as Ravnica's agricultural and reclamation sector.
events.quote: Founded by parun Svogthir , a devkarin necromancer -turned- lich , the Golgari Swarm functions as the agricultural and waste reclamation sector of Ravnican society.

events.summary: The Sisters of Stone Death attempt to overthrow Svogthir; they succeed and keep him under arrest in a tomb in Grigor Canyon.
events.quote: Less than a millennium before the Decamillennial, the Sisters of Stone Death , originally a quintet of gorgons , attempted to overthrow parun Svogthir.

events.summary: Savra, helped by Szadek, takes control of the guild, resurrects Svogthir to overthrow the Sisters, and proclaims herself guildmaster.
events.quote: After this, Savra proclaimed herself as the new Golgari guildmaster.

events.summary: Savra tries to infiltrate the Selesnya Conclave but is double-crossed by Szadek, who snaps her neck.
events.quote: she was double-crossed by Szadek, who snapped her neck to weaken the Conclave.

events.summary: In Dissension, Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother Jarad, who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.
events.quote: In Dissension , Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother, Jarad , who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.

events.summary: Izolda sacrifices Jarad in a ritual to arouse Rakdos, but he survives by becoming a zombie/lich and keeps leadership.
events.quote: He was later sacrificed by Izolda ( Lyzolda, the Blood Witch ) as part of a ritual to arouse Rakdos , the parun of the Cult of Rakdos .

events.summary: Jarad maintains his power, ruthlessly quelling dissent from the Teratogens.
events.quote: Jarad maintained his power, quelling without mercy any rumblings of mutiny or dissent from the Teratogens.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas rewards Vraska with the location where Jarad is imprisoned after the Immortal Sun affair on Ixalan.
events.quote: Pleased with the planewalker Vraska 's role in securing the Immortal Sun in Ixalan , Nicol Bolas rewarded her with the information where Jarad was imprisoned.

events.summary: Vraska frees Jarad and becomes the new Golgari leader herself.
events.quote: She took Jarad out and became the new leader herself.

events.summary: Vraska kills Isperia and flees to Ixalan to escape Ral Zarek, leaving the Golgari factions fighting for supremacy.
events.quote: After Vraska killed Isperia , she planeswalked to Ixalan to escape from being killed by Ral Zarek leaving the various Golgari factions fighting for supremacy.

events.summary: Vraska returns to Ravnica, unites the Golgari and pledges the guild against Bolas.
events.quote: Vraska united the Golgari once again and pledged the guild to the fight against Bolas.

events.summary: With Ajani's team, the Golgari evacuate many civilians to the tunnels beneath the city, safe from the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: With the help of Ajani and his team of planeswalkers, they were able to evacuate many civilians to the tunnels beneath the city, where they would be safe from the Dreadhorde .

events.summary: Vraska's return restores her leadership, except Matka Izoni, and rumors of Devkarin rebellion spread.
events.quote: When she returned all accepted her leadership again, except Matka Izoni.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, a recently compleated Vraska leads the Phyrexian forces on Ravnica.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , a recently Compleated Vraska led the Phyrexian forces on Ravnica.

events.summary: The Golgari fall to Phyresis faster than any other guild and swarm up from the Undercity to attack the surface.
events.quote: the Golgari fell to Phyresis faster than any other guild, experiencing near-total compleation, eventually swarming up through the Undercity to launch an all-out attack on the largely uncompleated surface.

events.summary: Korozda is brought to the surface by the Invasion Tree, cracking the ground and destroying many Golgari homes.
events.quote: Korozda was brought to the city's surface by the Invasion Tree, cracking the guildhall's surface and destroying many Golgari homes.

events.summary: After the invasion the other guilds denounce the Golgari, whose members are shunned and reviled.
events.quote: The Golgari were unanimously denounced by the other guilds, its members shunned and reviled.

events.summary: Golgari faction leaders denounce Vraska and strip her of her title, leaving the guild with no acting head.
events.quote: the remaining leaders of the various Golgari factions, in a rare show of unity, resoundingly denounced her and stripped her of her title in the hope of distancing themselves from her acts.

relations.quote: Founded by parun Svogthir , a devkarin necromancer -turned- lich , the Golgari Swarm functions as the agricultural and waste reclamation sector of Ravnican society.

relations.quote: she was double-crossed by Szadek, who snapped her neck to weaken the Conclave.
In Dissension , Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother, Jarad , who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.

relations.note: Jarad assumed control of the Swarm.
relations.quote: In Dissension , Szadek is defeated with the help of Savra's brother, Jarad , who assumes control of the Golgari Swarm.
She took Jarad out and became the new leader herself.

relations.note: Vraska killed Isperia before fleeing to Ixalan.
relations.quote: After Vraska killed Isperia , she planeswalked to Ixalan to escape from being killed by Ral Zarek leaving the various Golgari factions fighting for supremacy.

relations.note: She pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas.

relations.note: Under Mazirek the Kraul are loyal to Vraska rather than the Swarm.
relations.quote: Under Mazirek , the Kraul are loyal to Vraska , rather than to the Swarm as a whole.

relations.note: They returned as her zombie attendants.
relations.quote: They returned as Zombie Attendants of Vraska .
The leader of the Erstwhile is the lich Storrev .
The current leader of the Lotleth is Wratislav , a skilled but conceited human necromancer.

relations.note: Izoni is the Devkarin's current Matka.
She led the cult before becoming guild leader.
relations.quote: The cult was led by Vraska before she became the guild leader.
The Lotleth are the Golgari's irregular faction of undead , necromancers , fungus -binders, and other members associated with the restless dead.
